content: Lord of the three kāyas, knower of the ten, Lord of Dharma,Gurus, yidam deities,Ḍākinīs, dharma protectors, and all others,Dwell as witnesses to this dedication made with love.In this life and in other lives,Through my body, speech, and mind,Whatever white virtue I have gathered,For the sake of the benefit of all sentient beings,May I take the afflictions as the path,May I bring all appearances under my control,May I find the three kāyas within myself,May I accomplish the dharmakāya for my own benefit.Through the two form kāyas for the benefit of others,Until saṃsāra is emptied,With enlightened activity for the benefit of beings fully flourishing,Manifesting to each according to what is needed to tame them,May the vast benefit of others be accomplished.May those to be trained meet the opportune time,May I be skilled in the means of dependent origination,May all who connect with me find meaningful purpose,May the ocean of saṃsāra be emptied,May the clear light dharmakāya be attained.Just as all the Buddhas of the three timesHave performed their dedications,May I also accomplish such a dedication.Until the attainment of Buddhahood,May I be of noble birth, healthy, and clear-minded,Possessing morality, mindfulness, and practicing the Dharma,May I be honored by all,And may all hopes and desires be fulfilled.Until enlightenment is fully manifest,May diseases, spirits, and obstructions,Humans, beasts of prey, and rākṣasas,And the harms of the four elements,All be completely pacified.May lifespan and merit flourish,May glory and wealth increase,And may my renown be equal to the sky.May all activities of body, speech, and mind,Whatever I do, become a benefit for sentient beings,May the ocean of saṃsāra be emptied,And may perfect Buddhahood be attained.
